contract.goal: 3.0.0 ships no member whose only stated reason to exist is compatibility with an earlier release
contract.output: legacy Kafka header names removed (constants, write, read); ODataFilterExceptionHandler and its property removed with web-core required; LogFieldNames/JsonLogEncoderConfig non-canonical constructors removed; Redaction legacy markers removed and isMask narrowed; stale grpc-client POM comment fixed; one justified revapi.differences entry per removed element; CHANGELOG 3.0.0 in both locales
constraints: every revapi.differences entry added names this change and its replacement
no rule is weakened, no test disabled, to make progress
nothing outside the five surveyed items is removed or renamed (proposal non-goals)
done_when: scripts/manifest.sh build && scripts/manifest.sh stale && scripts/manifest.sh layout

decisions: 1.1: rollback_point is the last commit; add-grpc-starters and consolidate-grpc-contracts-and-tokens are both uncommitted beneath this change, so revert this change's files rather than resetting

survey: legacy headers have been dual-written since v1.1.0 (git log -S LEGACY_EVENT_TYPE: f1fdc5f, contained in v1.1.0 and v2.0.0), so both halves of the transition are removed in 3.0.0 with an upgrade precondition in the changelog rather than kept (design D1)

correction to the 1.1 decision: git status was clean at the start of this session - add-grpc-starters and consolidate-grpc-contracts-and-tokens are committed in fe88c0a, so fe88c0a is a clean rollback point for this change

2.1/2.2: EnvelopeReader's first(canonical, legacy) became text(headers, name); VersionGatingDeserializer reads ludwig-event-version only. The legacy-fallback tests were rewritten to assert the opposite (a legacy-only record reads as absent), and KafkaOutboxDispatcherTest is new - the dispatcher had no unit test - asserting none of the four pre-prefix names is written

3.1: web-core-spring-boot-starter loses <optional> in odata-filter's POM; the mapper and bundle lose their @ConditionalOnClass. NoLocalAdviceTest (module-local ArchUnit, file-action's shape) is the check. Of the two rules ArchitectureTest disabled with the reason 'the only controller is the legacy advice', web.controllers-do-not-call-controllers is re-enabled and passes; rest-paths fired on FilterMetadataController (its path is odata.filter.metadata.base-path, from configuration) and stays disabled with that reason written in place of the false one. web-core's and crud-service-example's READMEs mention the property only as history and were left as written

5.1: AuditStoreIntegrationTest spells "[redacted]" inline in an assertion rather than as a constant, so the SecondRedactionMask rule (which matches a static final String *MASK* declaration) has nothing to fire on; RedactionTest is new and asserts isMask rejects both retired markers

6.1: ten revapi.differences entries; the JSON inside the CDATA parses. To verify them rather than only syntax-check them, v2.0.0 was built from a temporary git worktree with -Drevision=2.0.0 -DskipTests -Drevapi.skip=true and installed into ~/.m2, after backing up the 41 ru/ludwigandreas maven-metadata-local.xml files; those 2.0.0 artifacts and the worktree are removed after the gate

6.1 verification: with the 2.0.0 baseline installed locally, an online build still compared [] - revapi's RELEASE resolution ignores locally installed versions - so the check was run offline (-o), which reads local metadata. At -Drevision=3.0.0-SNAPSHOT the semver rule accepts every breaking difference, so it proves nothing about the entries; at -Drevision=2.0.1-SNAPSHOT with --fail-never every touched module was compared against 2.0.0 and none of this change's twelve differences was reported. Two java.annotation.removed entries were added for the @ConditionalOnClass guards dropped from odata's bean methods. The spec's 'removal without an entry fails the gate' scenario was false at a major increment and was rewritten to what is actually checked

finding, outside this change's scope and not fixed: the first real baseline comparison reports 212 java.method.varargOverloadsOnlyDifferInVarargParameter problems on Spring and Jackson types in every module. A major increment hides them, but the first non-major release after 3.0.0 (3.0.1 or 3.1.0) will fail its revapi check on them. Also reported against non-major: architecture-rules' RuleGroup.CUSTOM ordinal shift (RuleGroup.GRPC inserted before it, from add-grpc-starters)

cleanup: the 34 locally built 2.0.0 / 2.0.1-SNAPSHOT / 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT version directories under ~/.m2/repository/ru/ludwigandreas were deleted, the 41 backed-up maven-metadata-local.xml files restored, and the v2.0.0 git worktree removed
